classification.difficultyReason: Identify the appropriate polygonal base, use its area formula and multiply by prism length; retain redundant measurements and equality marks.

content.prompt: Calculate the volumes of these solids.

spec.description: Unfilled rectangular prism with front rectangular face, top face and right face visible. Depth runs up-right. Labels: 3 cm beneath the front bottom horizontal edge; 6 cm beneath the lower right receding edge; 2 cm beside the rear right vertical edge. All depicted edges are solid blue; hidden edges are omitted.

Unfilled cube-like rectangular prism showing front, top and left faces; depth runs up-left. The front bottom horizontal edge is labelled 3 mm. Single matching ticks occur on that edge, the front left vertical edge and the lower left receding edge, asserting equal width, height and depth. Solid blue outlines; dark equality ticks; no hidden edges shown.

Unfilled triangular prism. Near triangular cross-section has a bottom right-angle vertex A, upper-left vertex B and upper-right vertex C. AB is labelled 1 cm; AC is labelled 2 cm. A right-angle square is at A. A quadrilateral face extends up-right from BC; its right receding edge is separately labelled 2 cm, the prism length. Solid blue visible edges; hidden edges omitted. The model describes the true triangular cross-section, not its perspective projection.

Upright unfilled triangular prism with the top triangular end and two vertical side faces visible. The top triangle's near central vertex carries a right-angle square. Corresponding lower cross-section legs are labelled 4 cm on the lower left sloping edge and 10 cm on the lower right sloping edge. The right vertical connecting edge is labelled 8 cm. Model vertices for the lower true cross-section: A is its lowest central vertex, B its upper-left vertex and C its upper-right vertex; AB = 4 cm and AC = 10 cm, with the right angle transferred from the congruent top end. Solid blue edges; hidden lower rear edge omitted.

Unfilled trapezoidal prism extending up-right. Near trapezium has short top and long bottom parallel edges, both marked with blue arrows. Labels: 4 mm inside near the short top edge; 11 mm below the long bottom edge; 12 mm beside the lower right receding edge. A red dashed perpendicular descends from the top-right trapezium vertex to the bottom edge, with a dark right-angle square at its foot. The 3 mm label has a dark leader pointing to this altitude. Top and right lateral faces are outlined; hidden edges omitted.

Long unfilled rectangular prism showing front, top and right end faces; depth runs up-right. The front bottom long edge is labelled 20 mm. The lower right receding edge is labelled 4 mm. All four edges of the right end face have matching single ticks, asserting a square end. Solid blue outlines and dark ticks; no hidden edges shown.

Unfilled prism with a front parallelogram cross-section, extending up-left to its rear end. Front bottom edge labelled 7 cm; upper right connecting edge labelled 8 cm. The front altitude is a red dashed vertical segment labelled 3.5 cm, with a dark right-angle marker on the bottom edge. Blue parallel arrows occur on the front top, front bottom and corresponding rear top edges. Top and left lateral faces are visible; hidden edges omitted.

Unfilled triangular prism with near triangular end at lower left and a large sloping lateral face extending up-right. True cross-section vertices: A bottom left, B top left, C bottom right. AB is vertical and labelled 5 m; AC is horizontal and labelled 7 m; a right-angle square is at A. The lower right receding edge is labelled 8 m. Solid blue visible edges; hidden edges omitted.

Upright unfilled trapezoidal prism. Top trapezium has a long rear horizontal edge labelled 7 m above it and a short front horizontal edge labelled 3 m below it, both with blue parallel arrows. Red dashed perpendicular joins the short edge's left endpoint to the long edge, labelled 2 m, with a dark right-angle square at the long edge. Right outer vertical connecting edge labelled 6 m. Front, left and right vertical faces are depicted; hidden rear lower edges omitted.

Tall, narrow triangular prism receding steeply up-right. Near true triangular cross-section: A bottom right, B bottom left, C directly above A. AB is labelled 12.2 cm. Matching single ticks on AB and AC assert equal legs; a right-angle square is at A. The lower right receding connecting edge is labelled 20.5 cm. The rear corresponding horizontal triangle edge is grey dashed; remaining depicted outlines are blue-teal and solid. Preserve the strongly slanted depth direction without treating the projected triangle as its metric shape.

Triangular prism with a light-blue filled near right-triangular end and a large unfilled lateral face extending up-left. True cross-section vertices: A bottom right, B bottom left, C top right. AB is labelled 8 mm; AC is labelled 6 mm; BC is separately labelled 10 mm; right-angle square at A. A second 10 mm label lies beside the upper right connecting edge and denotes prism length. Blue-teal solid outlines; hidden edges omitted.

Low trapezoidal prism extending up-right. Labels: 16.8 cm beneath the front long bottom edge; 8 cm above the corresponding rear short top edge; 7 cm beside the front left sloping cross-section edge; 5 cm beside the rear right sloping cross-section edge; 9 cm beside the lower right connecting edge. A dark vertical double-headed dimension arrow inside the front trapezium is labelled 4 cm and spans its parallel-edge separation. Grey dashed rear lower horizontal and rear left sloping edges are shown. Blue-teal solid visible outlines. Blue-grey shading highlights a broad lower region and the lower right face; the precise face ownership of the shading needs review.
